title: SkuIntentMapping
description: Intent-to-SKU linkage record for Intent Schema v1. Grounded in docs/plan/buyer-intent-lib-product-plan.md section M3: intents map N-to-M onto products/SKUs; match_strength is rule/semantic relevance and never a purchase-probability prediction.

schema_version.description: SemVer of the Intent Schema contract; major version must be 1.

mapping_id.description: Stable identifier for this intent-to-SKU mapping.

product_id.description: Owning product when the SKU belongs to a modeled product.

match_strength.description: Rule/semantic relevance between the intent and the SKU (plan M3). Not a purchase probability, expected CTR/CVR, or settlement value.

eligibility.description: Promotional/affiliate eligibility of the SKU; standalone mode emits 'unverified' until a later integration package confirms it.

landing_url.description: Landing page URL for this SKU in this mapping.

evidence_urls.description: Page evidence supporting this mapping; every mapping carries at least one URL.
